machine: Azure virtual machine (Virtual Machine); AMD EPYC 7763 64-Core Processor, 8 vCPU / 16 threads, 2445 MHz; 64 GB RAM; no GPU
os: Microsoft Windows Server 2025 Datacenter Azure Edition 10.0.26100
engine: llama.cpp b11935 Windows x64 CPU package llama-b11935-bin-win-cpu-x64.zip
model: Contoso-Kev-0.8B-FTcf-R2C-Q8_0.gguf (round-2 arm C, the delivered model: train_cf2, 4 epochs, T = 2.83)
data_provenance: scripts/gen_long_cases.py: 160 cases sampled with seed 23 from the same vendor-policy generator as the short sets; the case_history text and the short customer message were written by a large language model from a per-case fact list (the model wrote text only and never saw or decided a label); labels = vendor_policy.support_labels + long_labels() history clauses H1/H2/H3, computed in code. Two histories came back truncated (<3,000 characters) and were re-rendered before the set was built.

runs.note: real long inputs: data/contoso/final/long_test_support.jsonl (160 records, case_history 3k–30k characters), default arguments -c 8192 -b 2048 -ub 2048 --cache-ram 0, one request at a time

control: data/contoso/final/longshort_test_support.jsonl (the same 160 records with case_history removed, the three history clauses still appended to instructions; labels from the short-record policy), same arguments

control: data/contoso/final/longplain_test_support.jsonl (case_history removed AND the history clauses removed from instructions = exactly the training format; labels from the short-record policy), same arguments

scope: Accuracy of the delivered 0.8B round-2 C at 3k–8k-token inputs where the answer depends on a fact that appears only in the case history, with a matched control inside the set (same history length, decisive fact absent or opposite) and two history-removed runs that separate the effect of the long input from the effect of the changed instruction text. 7 of 160 long requests were refused by llama-server (context size 8192 exceeded) and are recorded as error rows, not scored. One run per set, x86-64 VM only; the Snapdragon laptop did not run these sets. Latency and memory are reported for the same runs.
path_note: This machine's absolute project prefix was removed from server.log, run.json server_args/model and summary files, leaving project-relative paths; no measured value was changed. GGUF files are kept locally, not in the repository.
